display.name: AI tools: what agents use
display.description: Tools and MCP calls in Claude Code and Codex, with success rates, durations and approval decisions. Built by DotFiles/config/signoz/dashboards/build.mjs.

spec.name: A

display.name: Claude Code tools
display.description: bash:<program> and mcp:<server>/<tool> are split out of Bash and mcp_tool.

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    attributes_string['tool_name'] = 'mcp_tool',
      concat('mcp:', JSONExtractString(attributes_string['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_server_name'),
             '/', JSONExtractString(attributes_string['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_tool_name')),
    attributes_string['tool_name'] = 'Bash',
      concat('bash:', replaceRegexpOne(arrayFirst(w -> NOT match(w, '^\\w+='), splitByWhitespace(replaceRegexpOne(JSONExtractString(attributes_string['tool_parameters'], 'full_command'), '^(\\s*cd\\s+\\S+\\s*(&&|;)\\s*)+', ''))), '^.*/', '')),
    attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  count() AS calls,
  round(100 * countIf(attributes_string['success'] = 'true') / count(), 1) AS success_pct,
  round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))) AS p95_ms
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'tool_result'
GROUP BY tool, agent_config
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 40

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  if(event = 'tool_result', concat('claude-code ', agent_config), 'codex') AS agent,
  server, tool, count() AS calls
FROM (
  SELECT
    attributes_string['event.name'] AS event,
    resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
    if(event = 'tool_result', JSONExtractString(attributes_string['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_server_name'), attributes_string['mcp_server']) AS server,
    if(event = 'tool_result', JSONExtractString(attributes_string['tool_parameters'], 'mcp_tool_name'), attributes_string['tool_name']) AS tool
  FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
  WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
    AND ((attributes_string['event.name'] = 'tool_result' AND attributes_string['tool_name'] = 'mcp_tool')
      OR (attributes_string['event.name'] = 'codex.tool_result' AND attributes_string['mcp_server'] != ''))
)
GROUP BY agent, server, tool
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 30

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  if(attributes_string['mcp_server'] = '', attributes_string['tool_name'],
     concat('mcp:', attributes_string['mcp_server'], '/', attributes_string['tool_name'])) AS tool,
  count() AS calls,
  round(100 * countIf(attributes_string['success'] = 'true') / count(), 1) AS success_pct,
  round(quantile(0.5)(toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))) AS p50_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(toFloat64OrZero(attributes_string['duration_ms']))) AS p95_ms
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'codex.tool_result'
GROUP BY tool
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 25

display.name: Tool approvals
display.description: Claude Code tool_decision: accepted or rejected, and by whom (config rule, hook, you).

spec.name: A
spec.query:
SELECT
  attributes_string['tool_name'] AS tool,
  resources_string['agent.config'] AS agent_config,
  attributes_string['decision_type'] AS decision,
  attributes_string['decision_source'] AS decided_by,
  count() AS times
FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
WHERE timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}}
  AND attributes_string['event.name'] = 'tool_decision'
GROUP BY tool, agent_config, decision, decided_by
ORDER BY times DESC
LIMIT 30
